title: The Geometric Wall: Manifold Structure Predicts Layerwise Sparse Autoencoder Scaling Laws
abstract: arXiv:2605.09887v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: SAEs operationalise the linear representation hypothesis: they reconstruct model activations as sparse linear combinations of dictionary atoms hypothesised to represent meaningful linear directions. Their reconstruction error varies sharply across layers in ways that existing scaling laws, fitted at a single layer, do not explain. We contend that this variation is the empirical trace of the changing geometric structure of activation manifolds across depth: as their intrinsic dimension and curvature vary from layer to layer, so does the difficulty of approximating them with sparse linear dictionaries, and SAE width-sparsity scaling becomes a layer-dependent function of manifold structure rather than a single universal law. translated_title: 几何之墙：流形结构预测稀疏自编码器的逐层缩放定律
translated_abstract: SAE（稀疏自编码器）将线性表示假设付诸实践：它们将模型激活重构为字典原子的稀疏线性组合，这些字典原子被假设为承载有意义的线性方向。其重构误差在各层之间变化剧烈，而已有的在单一层上拟合的缩放定律无法解释这一现象。我们认为，这种变化正是激活流形几何结构随深度演变的经验痕迹：随着流形的内在维度和曲率逐层变化，用稀疏线性字典对其进行逼近的难度也随之改变，因此 SAE 的宽度—稀疏度缩放规律成为流形结构的逐层依赖函数，而非单一的普适定律。我们开展了首个跨层 SAE 缩放研究，对横跨 Gemma 2 2B 和 9B 全部 68 层的 844 个残差流 Gemma Scope SAE 检查点拟合逐层缩放定律曲面，并将拟合所得…
tldr: 本文首次开展跨层稀疏自编码器缩放研究，发现激活流形的内在维度与曲率等几何结构随深度的变化能够逐层预测 SAE 的缩放定律，从而解释了重构误差为何在各层间剧烈波动。
en_tdlr: The first cross-layer SAE scaling study shows that the geometry of activation manifolds—intrinsic dimension and curvature—predicts layerwise SAE scaling laws, explaining why reconstruction error varies sharply across depth.
